profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary: I am Anthony Feenster, Sophomore Computer Science Major at Morgan State University, and through my first semester in college I obtained a 3.8 gpa, Dean’s list, a summer internship at Google and multiple placing efforts at Hackathons. This was all done as a first semester freshman. Through my second semester I attended more events getting my self acclimated to the Computer Science community and Networking with others in the field. I aspire to be a Software Engineer that advances the practical use of technology in our everyday lives.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I currently assist teaching/tutor computer science courses at Morgan State University. This helps me get connected with the newer codes at the university and help assure the next generation of coders at Morgan will be great ones.

honors.title: Dean’s List
honors.description: To Honor my high GPA for the semester.

projects.title: Wheel of Fortune
projects.description: The ClLI version of the Wheel of Fortune has been created. In the future I may begin to develop a GUI for this game.

projects.title: Lets HangOut
projects.description: An application that allows people to find a common time with their work schedule to have free time. I will begin to develop a gui for this soon.
